Subject: crude oil release at Hixon station
We had a crude oil release at our Hixon BC station on Sept 25 at 08:50. One of our
maintenance crews was working on the pipeline when it happened. The oil stayed within the
station fence.
The crew members don't agree on the volume released. One thinks it was around 1.1 m³,
while another estimates it was about 6 m³. We haven't taken a meter reading yet to confirm.
We're still investigating.
I'll keep you updated as we get more info.
Samantha Lee
Area Supervisor
